_about: L05 song-only characters, as staged in the L05 runsheet rev 2.7 (Baby Potato = a child's hand; Brinjal and Tomato the same height; Cabbage a little taller and twice as wide; Okra, Carrot, Radish, Beans and Amma Potato about 1.5x). Heights in metres against Mintu = 1.00 m.

characters.name: Baby Potato
characters.phrase: about as tall as a child's hand
characters.build: tiny round baby potato, stubby arms and legs

characters.name: Brinjal
characters.build: plump egg shape, wider at the bottom
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: about Baby Potato's height

characters.name: Tomato
characters.build: round, a little wider than tall, roly-poly
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: the same height as Baby Potato

characters.name: Cabbage
characters.build: round, about twice as wide as Baby Potato
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: a little taller than Baby Potato

characters.name: Amma Potato
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: about 1.5x the little vegetables

characters.name: Okra
characters.build: one slim upright pod, three times as tall as wide
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: about 1.5x Baby Potato

characters.name: Carrot
characters.build: tall upright carrot with a leaf tuft and big floppy feet
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: about 1.5x Baby Potato

characters.name: Radish
characters.build: long white upright radish with a leaf tuft
characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: about 1.5x Baby Potato

characters.name: Beans

characters.source: L05 runsheet rev 2.7: about 1.5x Baby Potato
